    """Mark each partition containing more than one 5."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(size, seps):
        boundaries = [-1] + sorted(seps) + [size]
        return [(boundaries[i] + 1, boundaries[i + 1])
                for i in range(len(boundaries) - 1)
                if boundaries[i] + 1 < boundaries[i + 1]]

    row_spans = spans(h, row_seps)
    col_spans = spans(w, col_seps)
    # The uniform separator lines are distinct from the non-uniform tile
    # contents in these tasks. Preserve the tile's ordinary background color.
    background = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 5), 0)

        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
